title: Quantum Basin — SE implementation jot
content:
Context: quick running log for Quantum Basin (retail analytics) Private deployment POC. Not a customer-facing doc — notes, commands, TODOs, decisions. Keep short and messy.

Summary goals:
- Get a VPC-private Redwood Private control plane connected to their AWS account (account: qb-prod-acc placeholder).
- Demo inference latency < 40ms p50 for short chat endpoints (seq_len ~256).
- Validate billing/usage passthrough requirements and KMS key integration.
- Start canary rollout to 3 internal services (ingester, query-api, agent-worker).

Immediate action items (today):
1) Confirm VPC peering CIDR with QB networking: they said 10.2.0.0/16 but asked to double-check overlapping subnets. Ask: any shared Transit-GW? (slack: #qb-net).
2) Upload customer KMS public key — need correct ARN format. I will check the KMS role stub we used for Harborfield POC and copy policy.
3) Run local perf calc for model variant A (llama2-13b-8bit) using our internal perfbench script with seq=256, batch=4, target p50 40ms.
4) Draft canary policy: 5% traffic -> 20% after 24h if no latency/regression + automatic fallback to hosted small model on errors.

Config checklist (notes to self):
- Private control plane: use image tag private-2026-02-rc2. Need customer CA bundle for mTLS.
- Required inbound from customer: only 443 to control plane EIP, SSH (22) to bastion host r/w. Avoid exposing admin ports.
- KMS integration: grant Encrypt/Decrypt to redwood-private-kms-role and AllowPolicy for audit logs.
- Storage: s3 bucket qb-redwood-logs with SSE-KMS, lifecycle 90d -> glacier for cold logs.
- Audit: enable S3 access logging + CloudTrail to qb-audit account for 365 days.

Model serving notes:
- Start with variant A: llama2-13b-q8 (optimised kernels), follower variant B: llama2-13b-int8 if memory pressured.
- Turn on prefix KV-cache for agent-worker flows (lots of repeated context), TTL 48h for session tokens.
- Batching: for query-api set continuous-batching with max_batch_size=8, batch_timeout_ms=25. For low-latency chat use batch_size=1/2.
- Sequence length distribution: typical queries 32–128 tokens; long analytics prompts up to 1024 (but rare). Make sure to attach longer sequence fallback to dedicated capacity lane to avoid latency SLO breaks.

Rollout plan (canary):
- Day 0: Deploy control plane + runtime onto two azs. Run smoke tests: health, kv-cache hitrate initial logging, model load times.
- Day 1: Canary 2% traffic (internal), monitor latencies, cost per token, and hallucination rate on eval set (we have the retail prompts).
- Day 2: Increase to 10% if stable. Run a regression eval (automated) comparing quality metrics to baseline hosted model.
- Day 3-4: 20% -> 50% -> full depending on SLOs. Use immediate rollback if p95 > 2x baseline or error rate > 0.5%.

Metrics / dashboards to wire up prior to canary:
- Token/sec and tokens per second per model instance.
- p50/p95/p99 latency per route.
- KV-cache hit ratio, prefix hit ratio, cache eviction rate.
- Cost per 1k tokens estimate per model variant.
- Quality regression: rouge-like score on eval set + custom business metric (CTR_sim).

Open questions / blockers:
- QB legal: do they require customer-managed HSM for key material? If yes, timeline will slip. (Contact: legal_beta@qb.com)
- Network: Transit-GW? They may rely on central egress to a firewall that blocks certain ephemeral ports—need their network diagram.
- Billing model: they want usage-based with monthly cap; need pricing contacts and internal billing flow.

Useful commands / snippets:
- Perf bench (local): ./perfbench --model llama2-13b-q8 --seq 256 --batch 4 --warmup 20 --measure 300
- Upload KMS policy (aws cli): aws kms put-key-policy --key-id alias/qb-redwood --policy file://qb-kms-policy.json --profile qb-admin
- Start canary via console API: curl -X POST https://private-controlplane.qb.example/api/v1/deployments -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"model_variant":"llama2-13b-q8","traffic_pct":2,"rollback_on_errors":true}'

Meeting notes (2026-02-25 call w/ QB infra + infra-ops):
- QB raised concern about long-lived sessions and cost creep. Suggested using per-session hard limits + early cutoff tokens.
- They prefer pinned model version per environment (dev/stage/prod). We should expose UI toggle and API param.
- They want quarterly audits and exportable logs in csv. Noted.

Follow-ups (assign):
- @Sofia: check kernel selection heuristics for large context (is our runtime selecting efficient FlashAttention variant for seq=1024?).
- @Diego: prepare small runbook for recovering KV-cache after instance replacement (steps + quick commands).
- @Ethan (me): coordinate KMS policy and confirm peering CIDR.

Random notes / scratch lines (throwaway):
- Consider recommending quantization profile "q8-ev2" if memory pressure becomes >85% on 13B.
- Could batch retail queries by store-id to increase effective cache hits. Quick experiment idea.
- Put a short eval harness in repo: /playbooks/qb-evals/retail-smoke - run nightly.

End of jot.

If this goes stale, rename copy: quantum-basin-se-impl-jot-archived-YYYYMMDD.json
